changelog:
Initial release supporting landscaping & lawn care operations in the US market.

- Provides detailed service pricing benchmarks for residential, commercial, and per-acre work
- Outlines typical profit margins, equipment ROI standards, and licensing requirements
- Offers guidance on key business KPIs and growth stages
- Shares actionable tips on route optimization, contract structure, and service upselling
- Emphasizes compliance and operational best practices for sustainable business growth
summary: Advisor for landscaping and lawn care business operations, pricing, route planning, crew management, compliance, and revenue growth strategies.
